mechanisms.pattern: lexer normalizer: `fun x =>` as `λx =>`, a trailing `(fun ...)` argument bare, `f (g x)` as `f $ g x` (normalize_check.py)

`all_goals repeat first | assumption | exact $A | (apply $B ∘ $C ?_ ?_ ∘ $D) | (intro $E; cases $E)` -> `all_goals repeat first | assumption | (apply $B ∘ $C ?_ ?_ ∘ $D) | exact $A | (intro $E; cases $E)`

`obtain ⟨$A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F⟩ := $G ($H := ⊤) $ $I $J ⏎ refine (($K $L).$M $N ?_ (by rw [$F, $O]; exact $P)).$Q $ by` -> `obtain ⟨$A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F⟩ := $G $ $I $J ⏎ refine (($K $L).$M $N ?_ (by rw [$F, $O]; apply $P)).$Q $ by`
`$ by exact fun $A $B $C => $D ($A+$B)` -> `$ by exact fun $A $B $C => $D $ $A+$B`
`simp ($A := omega) only [$B] at $C $D ⏎ simp ($A := omega) only [$E] at $C` -> `simp ($A := omega) only [$B, $E] at $C $D`

`all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim ($A := 8) [$B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H, $I, $J]` -> `all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim [$B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H, $I, $J]`
`all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim [$A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H, $I]` -> `all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim [$A, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H, $I]`
`any_goals apply $A ⏎ $B first | assumption | apply $C | apply $D` -> `$B apply $C ⏎ all_goals first | assumption | apply $A | apply $D`
`all_goals first | assumption | apply $A` -> `any_goals assumption ⏎ all_goals apply $A`

`all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim only [*, $A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H]` -> `any_goals left; solve_by_elim ⏎ all_goals right; solve_by_elim only [*, $A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H]`
`case' $A | $B => cases $C <;> rename_i $C ⏎ case $D | $D => use $E, $F $C, $G (.$H $E)` -> `case' $A | $B => cases $C ⏎ case $D | $D => use $E, $F ‹_›, $G (.$H $E)`
`($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (by intro $B $C $F; apply $G)` -> `($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (by intro $B $C $F; exact $G _)`
`($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (fun $B => by simp [$F, $G, $H])` -> `($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (fun $B => by simp only [$F, $G, $H, implies_true, and_self])`
`refine (($A $B).$C $D ?_ (by rw [$E, $F]; apply $G)).$H $ by` -> `refine' (($A $B).$C $D ?_ (by rw [$E, $F]; apply $G)).$H $ by`
`simp only [$A, $B, ← $C, ← $D ($E ($F $G $H)), ← $D $I, $J] at $K ⏎ rw [← $L, $M] at $K` -> `simp only [$A, ← $L, $M, $B, ← $C, ← $D ($E ($F $G $H)), ← $D $I, $J] at $K`
`case' $A | $B => cases $C ⏎ case $D | $D => exact ⟨_, $E ‹_›, .$F (.$G _)⟩` -> `case' $A | $B => cases $C <;> rename_i $C ⏎ case $D | $D => exact ⟨_, $E $C, .$F (.$G _)⟩`
`$A first | assumption | apply $B | apply $C | apply $D` -> `any_goals apply $B ⏎ $A first | assumption | apply $D | apply $C`

`obtain ⟨$A, $B, $C, $D⟩ := ($E (fun _ : $F 4 => $G $H $I)).$J ⏎ ($K := fun $L ($M : $F 4) => $N ($L+$M)) (by intro $L $M $O; exact $P _)` -> `obtain ⟨$A, $B, $C, $D⟩ := ($E (fun _ => $G $H $I)).$J ⏎ ($K := fun $L ($M : $F 4) => $N ($L+$M)) (by intro $L $M $O; apply $P)`
`($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (by intro $B $C $F; exact $G _)` -> `($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (by intro $B $C $F; apply $G)`

`all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim [$A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H]` -> `all_goals first | left; solve_by_elim | right; solve_by_elim only [*, $A, $B, $C, $D, $E, $F, $G, $H]`
`rw [$A] at $B $C ⏎ simp only [swap] at $B $C` -> `simp only [$A, swap] at $B $C`
`refine' (($A $B).$C $D ?_ (by rw [$E, $F]; apply $G)).$H $ by` -> `refine' (($A $B).$C $D ?_ $ by rw [$E, $F]; apply $G).$H $ by`

`all_goals $A first | simp_all only [$B, $C, $D] | casesm* $E .., $F .., $G .., $H (.$I _), $H (.$J _) | cases $K` -> `all_goals $A first | simp_all only [$B, $C, $D] | casesm* $E .., $F .., $G .., $H (.$I _), $H (.$J _) <;> subst_vars | cases $K`
`simp ($A := omega) only [$B] ⏎ simp ($A := omega) only [$C, $D]` -> `simp ($A := omega) only [$B, $C, $D]`
`all_goals $A repeat first | assumption | refine $B $ $C ?_ ?_` -> `all_goals $A repeat first | assumption | apply $B; apply $C`
`all_goals first | assumption | apply $A | apply $B` -> `all_goals first | assumption | apply $B`
`($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (fun $B => by exact fun $C $F => $G _)` -> `($A := fun $B ($C : $D 4) => $E ($B+$C)) (by intro $B $C $F; exact $G _)`

`($A := fun $B : $C => fun $D : $E 4 => $F ($B+$D)) (fun $B => by constructor <;> intro $D; exact ($G _).1; exact ($G _).2)` -> `($A := fun $B : $C => fun $D : $E 4 => $F ($B+$D)) (fun $B => by exact ⟨fun $D => ($G _).1, fun $D => ($G _).2⟩)`
delete the line `case' $A => split <;> try split`

inside a line `(by rw [$A, $B]; apply $C)` -> `$ by rw [$A, $B]; apply $C`

inside a line `(by exact fun $A $B $C => $D ($A+$B)` -> `$ by exact fun $A $B $C => $D ($A+$B`
inside a line `(show $A _ _ = $B from $C rfl)` -> `show $A _ _ = $B from $C rfl`
inside a line `fun $A => by exact fun $B $C =>` -> `by intro $A $B $C; exact`
